title: Service Manager - EV DC Fast Chargers
description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a Service Manager to build and lead the after-sales service function for our DC fast chargers (60 kW and above) across North India. Based in Delhi NCR, you will own field service delivery end-to-end — from first-level troubleshooting at customer sites to setting up the SOPs, KPIs and team that keep our chargers running at high uptime for CPOs, fleet operators and site owners.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will diagnose field issues yourself when needed, while coaching and growing a team of service engineers and partner technicians. The role will initially report to the Head of Sales.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Service Leadership:** Build, lead and grow the after-sales service team (service engineers and partner technicians) across North India — plan manpower, allocate field visits, set priorities and own team performance.

* **SOPs & Process Set-up:** Establish the service function's standard operating procedures from the ground up: installation and commissioning checklists, preventive maintenance schedules, ticketing and escalation workflows, spares and RMA handling, site safety (LOTO, PPE) and field reporting formats.

* **First-Level Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve field issues on DC chargers, on-site or remotely — power module and rectifier faults, contactor/relay and protection device trips, auxiliary SMPS failures, input supply and earthing issues, connector/cable faults, communication failures (CAN, RS-485, Ethernet/4G) and vehicle–charger handshake errors.

* **Escalation & Root Cause Analysis:** Capture structured fault data (logs, error codes, measurements, photos), escalate to engineering and firmware teams with clear evidence, and drive RCA and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) to closure.

* **Uptime & SLAs:** Own charger uptime, response and resolution time (MTTR) and first-time-fix rate against warranty and AMC commitments; publish service dashboards and reports to management.

* **Installation & Commissioning:** Oversee site readiness checks, installation quality, commissioning and handover of new chargers, working closely with EPC contractors and electrical partners.

* **Preventive Maintenance & AMC:** Plan and execute preventive maintenance schedules, and support the sales team on AMC proposals, renewals and service pricing.

* **Spares & RMA:** Plan spares requirements and regional inventory, manage warranty claims and the repair/return cycle with the factory.

* **Customer Interface:** Act as the primary service contact for CPOs, fleet operators and site owners — handle escalations calmly and professionally, and build long-term customer confidence.

* **Coaching & Training:** Coach and mentor service engineers; run technical training for the team, installation partners and customer site staff on operation, safety and basic troubleshooting.

* **Field-to-Product Feedback:** Feed recurring field failures, site conditions and customer feedback back to product, quality and NPD teams to improve reliability.

**A NOTE ON REQUIREMENTS**

We value hands-on problem solvers who can lead from the field. If you match most of the core requirements below and are excited to build a service function from the ground up at a fast-growing company, we strongly encourage you to apply.

**CORE REQUIREMENTS (WHAT YOU BRING DAY 1)**

* **Education:** Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

* **Experience:** 8–10 years in after-sales / field service, with a proven track record of managing after-sales support for EV DC chargers.

* **Team Leadership:** Experience leading a field service team — allocating work, tracking performance, and coaching engineers and technicians.

* **Electrical & Electronics Troubleshooting:** Working understanding of three-phase AC input, rectifier and DC-DC power modules, contactors, MCB/MCCB, SPD, RCD/insulation monitoring and earthing; able to read wiring diagrams and electrical schematics to fault-find on field chargers.

* **Test Equipment:** Confident use of multimeter, clamp meter, insulation resistance tester (megger) and earth tester, plus laptop-based diagnostics and log retrieval.

* **Charging Communication Basics:** Basic understanding of CCS2 charging, OCPP backend connectivity and CAN/RS-485/Modbus, enough to isolate communication and network faults.

* **Process & SOP Discipline:** Hands-on experience writing and running SOPs, ticketing/CRM tools and service KPIs (uptime, MTTR, first-time-fix rate).

* **Electrical Safety:** Sound knowledge of safe working practices on high-voltage AC/DC equipment (LOTO, PPE, earthing and isolation checks).

* **Languages:** Fluent spoken and written Hindi and English — critical for working with customers, site teams and partner technicians.

* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel extensively across Delhi NCR, North, Est & West India for site visits and escalations.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE (OR WHAT YOU CAN LEARN WITH US)**

* Prior service experience with a DC charger OEM or a charge point operator (CPO) in India.

* Exposure to EV charging standards (IEC 61851, DIN 70121, ISO 15118) and OCPP 1.6J / 2.0.1 backend diagnostics.

* Background in adjacent power electronics service — UPS, solar inverters, industrial drives (VFDs) or telecom power systems.

* Electrical Supervisor competency certificate or equivalent electrical safety certification.

* Familiarity with field service / CRM tools (e.g., Zoho, Salesforce Field Service, Freshdesk) and remote monitoring dashboards.

* Experience setting up a service function or regional service hub at a growth-stage company.

title: Founding Engineer - Voice AI
description:
**Company Description**

We’re building self-healing voice agents for enterprise customer support within ixigo. The system has to know when it’s failing, why it’s failing, and how to fix itself before a human notices. This fellowship sits at the intelligence layer behind that work.

 **Job Description**

We need a founding engineer to own the voice AI product end to end: the cascaded pipeline that turns a phone call into a real-time conversation. This is not a research role and not a generic backend role. It is the person who understands, at the millisecond level, why a voice agent feels slow, where the latency actually lives across the STT, LLM, and TTS legs, and how to claw it back without breaking conversation quality.

You will have access to real production call traces and a live traffic testing ground from day one. Decisions you make ship to real customer-facing calls within days, not quarters.

**What you'll own**

* The end-to-end latency budget across the cascaded pipeline (STT finalization, LLM prefill and generation, TTS time-to-first-byte), with a target of sub-1-second end-to-end response time
* Diagnosing and fixing cross-cutting bottlenecks that touch multiple pipeline legs at once, for example, prompt size and cache-hit rate degrading prefill time, network payload, and throughput contention simultaneously
* Evaluating and integrating STT/LLM/TTS providers (including in-region India options) against the latency and quality bar, and building the abstraction layer that keeps us model-agnostic and provider-swappable
* Turn detection, interruption and barge-in handling, filler audio, and retry logic, the mechanics that make a bot feel like it is actually listening
* Instrumentation and tracing across the full call lifecycle so every latency regression is diagnosable from data, not guesswork
* Making the build vs. buy call on pipeline components as the product scales beyond the current reference customer

**Non-negotiable**

You have hands-on, production experience optimizing a cascaded voice pipeline or voice harness, meaning STT, LLM orchestration, and TTS stitched together into a live conversational system, not a single-model or text-only pipeline. You can talk concretely about where latency hides in each leg, what trade-offs you made between accuracy and speed, and what broke when you pushed the system harder. If your voice AI experience is limited to calling a hosted conversational API (Twilio Voice, a managed voicebot platform) without touching the pipeline internals, this is not a fit, regardless of years of experience elsewhere.

**Other requirements**

* 3-5 years minimum building and operating production systems at scale, with real on-call or ownership experience, not just feature delivery
* Strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, network I/O, profiling, and the instinct to measure before optimizing
* Comfortable working with ambiguous, partially-specified problems and real production data rather than clean specs
* Direct, low-ego communication. You will get short, blunt feedback and are expected to push back with data when you disagree

**Strong nice-to-haves**

* Experience with WebRTC, telephony infrastructure (SIP/PSTN), or real-time audio streaming
* Familiarity with prompt caching mechanics and how prefill cost scales with context length
* Experience in a founding or very early-stage (pre-seed to seed) environment where you owned a system with no safety net

 **Additional Information**

Responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we're disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

### **About the Job**

You will play a critical, hands-on role in guiding enterprise customers through the foundational stages of their deployment journey. As a **player-coach and technical anchor for a focused four-person onboarding team**, you will split your time between directly delivering complex customer onboardings and serving as the day-to-day technical escalation point and mentor for three fellow engineers.

Sitting at the intersection of technical architecture and customer delivery, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, steering customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.

For fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self-managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deploy secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.

**Hands-on Technical Onboarding (~70–80%)**

* Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to define success criteria, milestones, architecture patterns, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Guide the provisioning of Neo4j AuraDB environments and self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, and peering.

title: Production Support Engineer
description:
### **About Hupo**

We are an AI-native start-up building sales enablement products in the banking, financial services, and insurance industry; already trusted by **dozens of enterprise customers** (including Fortune 500 companies).

### **Role at a Glance**

**Title:** Production Support Engineer  
**Team:** Engineering, reporting to the Director of Engineering  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Location:** APAC (remote, with a preference for the Philippines, Vietnam, India or Singapore)  
**Working Hours:** APAC business hours, with at least four hours of overlap with the India team

### **Why This Role Matters**

As our client base grows, so does the number of technical issues that require hands-on investigation. We're looking for a Production Support Engineer who can dig into escalated issues, identify root causes, reproduce bugs and ship small, safe fixes through our normal release process.

You'll work closely with Technical Support, which handles initial client responses and communication, and our existing on-call engineers, who own incident command, mitigation and root-cause analysis. You'll investigate issues, provide clear technical findings and help resolve routine escalations without pulling product engineers away from their core work.

After your first 60 days, you'll join the existing on-call rotation. The goal is to build a stronger production support function that resolves technical issues efficiently while allowing our product engineers to focus on building and improving Hupo.

### **What You'll Do**

**Investigate and reproduce production issues**

* Review logs, traces and session data to identify the causes of escalated client issues, using approved tools and least-privilege access.
* Reproduce production issues, especially those involving voice, audio, browsers and connectivity, including hands-on troubleshooting with clients or their IT teams when needed.
* Determine whether an issue is a bug, configuration problem, feature request or user error, and document your findings so Technical Support can communicate them clearly to clients.

**Ship small fixes and escalate complex issues**

* Implement small, low-risk fixes through code review and the standard release process, linking each pull request to its corresponding ticket. Direct changes in production are not permitted.
* Involve Engineering or Product when an issue requires a larger fix, providing the identified cause, impact and a suggested approach.
* Keep technical findings and ticket statuses up to date in Jira so Technical Support can provide accurate client updates.

**Support incident response**

* During incidents, gather evidence, reproduce issues and test potential fixes under the direction of the on-call engineer.
* Turn the on-call engineer's root-cause analysis (RCA) into a clear, client-ready technical summary for Technical Support.
* Work alongside the on-call engineer while respecting their ownership of incident command, mitigation and the RCA process.
* Join the existing on-call rotation after completing your first 60 days.

**Own and improve support tooling**

* Build and maintain support tooling and integrations, starting with routing tickets from our helpdesk platform (currently Gleap) into Jira using the rules defined by Technical Support.
* Improve the diagnostic tools used by Technical Support and the on-call team, including log access, session lookup, admin tools and saved queries.
* Analyse ticket trends to identify recurring technical issues and recommend permanent product fixes to Engineering and Product, backed by relevant data.
* Write and maintain technical troubleshooting documentation for the knowledge base.

### **What Success Looks Like**

Within your first few months, you'll:

* Independently investigate and reproduce common production issues, providing clear findings and actionable next steps.
* Resolve routine, low-risk issues through safe code changes and the standard release process, reducing the number of ordinary escalations reaching product engineers.
* Establish reliable ticket routing and diagnostic workflows between Gleap, Jira and the relevant internal teams.
* Improve the quality of technical information available to Technical Support, enabling faster and more accurate client communication.
* Become familiar with our production systems, troubleshooting workflows and incident response practices, preparing to join the on-call rotation after your first 60 days.

You'll also be expected to continuously:

* Identify recurring issues and opportunities to prevent problems rather than repeatedly address symptoms.
* Improve support tooling, diagnostics and troubleshooting documentation as the product and client base grow.
* Work closely with Technical Support, the on-call team, Engineering and Product to resolve issues efficiently.
* Adapt and expand your impact as Hupo's technical support needs evolve.

### **What We're Looking For**

#### **Must-Haves**

* 3–5 years of experience in production support engineering or product support engineering, with hands-on production debugging experience. This is a mid-level engineering role, not a helpdesk position.
* Comfortable reading logs and traces, querying MongoDB and SQL databases, and reproducing issues based on user reports.
* Ability to write and ship small, safe fixes in TypeScript or Python, including opening clear pull requests and following standard code review and release processes.
* Working knowledge of web and network fundamentals, including browsers, permissions, HTTP, authentication, firewalls and network whitelisting.
* Experience with Jira and a helpdesk tool, including building integrations using APIs or webhooks.
* Strong data-handling practices, including using approved tools, respecting access controls and keeping client data within authorised environments.
* Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical causes to non-engineers and prepare summaries suitable for clients.
* Willingness to work directly with clients' IT and security teams when issues involve their environments.
* Willingness to participate in the on-call rotation after the initial 60-day period.
* Ability to meet the background-check requirements of our banking clients.

#### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with real-time audio or video, WebRTC, speech-to-text or text-to-speech systems.
* Familiarity with SSO and SAML, and LMS or SCORM integrations.
* Experience supporting enterprise clients in banking, financial services or insurance.
* Experience supporting an LLM or AI product in production.

### **Our Tech Stack**

* **Languages and services:** TypeScript on Node.js (Fastify), Python
* **Databases and caching:** MongoDB, PostgreSQL and Redis
* **Infrastructure and deployment:** AWS, EKS, ECS, GitHub Actions and ArgoCD
* **Voice:** LiveKit and third-party speech providers
* **Identity and authentication:** Auth0, SSO and SAML integrations with client identity providers
* **Monitoring and diagnostics:** Sentry, logs and traces
* **Support and issue tracking:** Jira and Gleap

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a **Senior** **SDET** to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow. This role is focused on the execution of pre-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour.

The ideal candidate has strong distributed-systems and API-testing experience and maintains disciplined technical evidence capture and traceability.

This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre-approved benign scenarios.

**Project Details**  
  
**Title:** Senior SDET  
**Rate:** $13.5/hr
  
**Start Date:** 19th October  
**Duration:** 5 Weeks  
**Commitment**: 33 Hours per Week  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Job Type:** Freelance

### **Responsibilities**

* Analyze distributed system APIs to validate correctness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record-linking
* Execute pre-approved request variations and boundary-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints.
* Investigate system behavior under malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly
* Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data-handling requirements.
* Validate behavior of near-real-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer-running background verification/risk pipelines (evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer of defense behaves as expected
* Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing
* Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed API behavior.
* Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET.
* Document observable account/CID lifecycle behavior and downstream state changes for handoff
* Capture and archive test logs and evidence in a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post-incident reviews
* Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, and validate fixes for distributed-system defects
* Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure-mode and chaos-style testing
* Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements
* Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Strong experience of **5-8+ years** in testing distributed systems and analyzing inter-service API behavior
* Hands-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques
* Understanding of layered defense architectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes
* Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores
* Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices
* Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries
* Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases
* Strong analytical and investigative skills for root-causing complex, systemic defects
* Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred.
* Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence-based reporting requirements is a plus
